title_en: Kitāb al-Zuhd of Abū Ḥātim al-Rāzī

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ الرَّازِيُّ قَالَ: ⦗ص: 30⦘ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنِ الْأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
entries.matn_ar: " إِنَّكُمْ لَمُغْفِلُونَ أَفْضَلَ الْعِبَادَةِ: التَّوَاضُعَ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim Muhammad b. Idris al-Hanzali al-Razi narrated to us. He said: [p. 30] Abu Nu'aym narrated to us. He said: Mis'ar narrated to us, from Sa'id b. Abi Burda, from al-Aswad, from 'A'isha, who said:
entries.matn_en: “You are neglectful of the best worship: humility.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، ⦗ص: 31⦘ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ ابْنُ فُسْحُمَ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ فِي يَدِهِ تَمَرَاتٌ، فَأَلْقَى بِهَا، وَقَالَ: «هَذِهِ مَعَ الدُّنْيَا، ثُمَّ تَقَدَّمَ فَقَاتَلَ حَتَّى قُتِلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Dukayn narrated to us. He said: Mis'ar narrated to us, [p. 31] from Abu Bakr b. Hafs, who said:
entries.matn_en: On the day of Badr, Ibn Fushum had some dates in his hand; he threw them away and said: “These belong with this world.” Then he advanced and fought until he was killed.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَ عِيسَى عليه السلام ⦗ص: 32⦘ يَأْكُلُ الشَّجَرَ، وَيَلْبَسُ الشَّعْرَ، وَيَبِيتُ حَيْثُ يُمْسِي، وَلَا يُخَبِّئُ لِغَدٍ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ وَلَدٌ يَمُوتُ، وَلَا بَيْتٌ يَخْرَبُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Dukayn narrated to us. He said: Mis'ar narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Murra, from Mujahid, who said:
entries.matn_en: Jesus (a) [p. 32] used to eat from the trees and wear hair [garments], and he would spend the night wherever evening found him, and he did not store anything for the morrow. He had no child who might die and no house that might fall into ruin.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: ⦗ص: 33⦘ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ: " أَنَّ مُوسَى، سَأَلَ رَبَّهُ، فَقَالَ: أَيْ رَبِّ، مَنِ الَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ دَارَ قُدْسِكَ؟ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: يَا مُوسَى، هُمُ النَّقِيَّةُ أَيْدِيهِمْ، الطَّاهِرَةُ قُلُوبُهُمْ، الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرْتُ ذُكِرُوا، وَإِذَا ذَكَرُونِي ذَكَرْتُهُمُ، الَّذِينَ يَتَحَابُّونَ بِجَلَالِي، وَيَعْمُرُونَ مَسَاجِدِي، وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ بِالْأَسْحَارِ، الَّذِينَ يُنِيبُونَ إِلَى ذِكْرِي كَمَا تُنِيبُ النُّسُورُ إِلَى وُكُورِهَا، الَّذِينَ يَغْضَبُونَ لِمَحَارِمِي كَمَا يَغْضَبُ النَّمِرُ إِذَا حَرِبَ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. Tarif narrated to us. He said: [p. 33] Isma'il b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Zayd b. Aslam:
entries.matn_en: That Moses asked his Lord and said: O my Lord, who are those who inherit the abode of Your holiness? He said: O Moses, they are those whose hands are clean and whose hearts are pure; those who, when I am mentioned, are mentioned, and when they mention Me, I mention them; those who love one another through My majesty, who populate My mosques, and who seek forgiveness in the hours before dawn; those who turn back to the remembrance of Me as eagles turn back to their nests; those who become angry for the sake of My prohibitions as the tiger becomes enraged when it is provoked.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ: " أَنَّ سَائِلًا سَأَلَ يَعْقُوبَ فَقَالَ: عَمَّ نُحُولُ جِسْمِكَ، وَسُقُوطُ حَاجِبَيْكَ عَلَى عَيْنَيْكَ؟ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: طُولُ الزَّمَانِ، وَكَثْرَةُ الْأَحْزَانِ، فَأَوْحَى اللَّهُ تبارك وتعالى إِلَيْهِ: يَا يَعْقُوبُ، أَتَشْكُونِي إِلَى عِبَادِي؟ قَالَ: أَيْ رَبِّ، خَطِيئَةٌ أَخْطَأْتُهَا، وَذَنْبٌ أَذْنَبْتُهُ، فَاغْفِرْ لِي "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan narrated to us. He said: Isma'il narrated to us, from Sulayman b. Sulaym:
entries.matn_en: That a questioner asked Jacob: Why is your body so wasted, and why do your eyebrows droop over your eyes? He said: The length of time and the abundance of sorrows. Then God, Blessed and Exalted, revealed to him: O Jacob, do you complain of Me to My servants? He said: O my Lord, it was a fault I committed and a sin I committed; so forgive me.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ: أَنَّ الْمَسِيحَ عليه السلام قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «يَا مَعْشَرَ الْحَوَارِيِّينَ، إِنْ أَحْبَبْتُمْ أَنْ تَكُونُوا مِنْ أَصْفِيَاءِ اللَّهِ، وَنُورِ بَنِي آدَمَ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ، فَأَصْلِحُوا بَيْنَ النَّاسِ، وَأَحِبُّوا مَنْ بَغَضَكُمْ» . قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ بَعْضَ مَنْ يَقْرَأُ الْكُتُبَ: إِنَّهُ مَكْتُوبٌ فِي الْإِنْجِيلِ: «أَفْلَحَ الَّذِينَ يُصْلِحُونَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ، أُولَئِكَ خَصَائِصُ اللَّهِ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Tarif narrated to us, from Isma'il, from Tha'laba b. Muslim, from Abu 'Imran al-Ansari:
entries.matn_en: That the Messiah (a) said: “O company of the disciples (al-hawariyyun), if you wish to be among God’s chosen ones and the light of the children of Adam among His creation, then reconcile people, and love those who hate you.” He said: And I heard some of those who read the books [say]: It is written in the Gospel: “Successful are those who reconcile people; those are God’s elect (khasa'is) among His creation.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 35⦘ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ يَزِيدَ بْنَ مَيْسَرَةَ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " يُقَالُ لِصَاحِبِ السُّلْطَانِ: أَيُّهَا الْمُسَلَّطُ، لَا يَنْفُخُكَ رَوْحُ السُّلْطَانِ؛ فَإِنَّكَ إِنَّمَا خُلِقْتَ مِنْ تُرَابٍ، وَإِلَى تُرَابٍ تَعُودُ، وَرِثْتَ مَكَانَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكَ ، وَغَيْرُكَ وَارِثٌ مَكَانَكَ غَدًا "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Tarif narrated to us. He said: [p. 35] Isma'il b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Safwan b. 'Amr, that Yazid b. Maysara said:
entries.matn_en: It is said to the man of authority: O you who have been given power, let not the spirit of authority puff you up; for you were created only from dust, and to dust you will return. You have inherited the place of one who came before you, and another will inherit your place tomorrow.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ الْكِنَانِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ فِي جَنَازَةٍ، فَرَأَى أَهْلَ الْمَيِّتِ يَبْكُونَ عَلَيْهِ، فَقَالَ: «مَسَاكِينُ، مَوْتَى غَدًا يَبْكُونَ عَلَى مَيِّتِ الْيَوْمِ؟ »
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Tarif narrated to us. He said: Isma'il narrated to us, from Sulayman b. Sulaym al-Kinani, from Yahya b. Jabir, who said:
entries.matn_en: Abu al-Darda' went out to a funeral and saw the family of the dead man weeping over him. He said: “Poor wretches! Will those who are the dead of tomorrow weep over the dead man of today?”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: {فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ لِلْأَوَّابِينَ ⦗ص: 36⦘ غَفُورًا} [الإسراء: 25] ، قَالَ: «التَّوَّابِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Tarif narrated to us. He said: Kathir b. Sulaym narrated to us, from al-Hasan, concerning His saying:
entries.matn_en: {For He is ever Forgiving to the oft-returning (al-awwabin) [p. 36]} [Q. 17:25]. He said: “The repentant (al-tawwabin).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَسْرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُمْ سَأَلُوا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَائِشَةَ فِي قَوْلِهِ فِي الْمَلَائِكَةِ: {ثُمَّ أَوْرَثَنَا الْكِتَابَ} [فاطر: 32] ، قَالَتْ: السَّابِقُ بِالْخَيْرَاتِ: مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم، وَالْمُقْتَصِدُ: أَصْحَابُهُ، وَالظَّالِمُ لِنَفْسِهِ: مِثْلِي وَمِثْلُكَ وَمِثْلُ هَذَا "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Tarif narrated to us. He said: Jasr narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi 'Abd al-Rahman:
entries.matn_en: That they asked the Mother of the Believers 'A'isha about His saying concerning the angels: {Then We gave the Book as an inheritance} [Q. 35:32]. She said: The one who is foremost in good deeds (al-sabiq bi-l-khayrat) is Muhammad ﷺ; the moderate one (al-muqtasid) is his Companions; and the one who wrongs himself is the like of me, and the like of you, and the like of this one.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَسْرٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: خَرَجَ فِي جَنَازَةٍ، فَصَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ خَفِيفَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ اتَّكَأَ عِنْدَ قَبْرٍ، فَنَعَسَ أَنَسٌ، فَخَرَجَ إِلَيْهِ صَاحِبُ الْقَبْرِ فَقَالَ: كَأَنَّكَ تَهَاوَنْتَ بِرَكْعَتَيْكَ قَبْلُ، لَئِنْ نَقْدِرُ عَلَى مِثْلِهَا أَحَبُّ إِلَيْنَا مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا، إِنَّكُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ وَلَا تَعْلَمُونَ، وَإِنَّا نَحْنُ نَعْلَمُ وَلَا نَقْدِرُ عَلَى الْعَمَلِ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Tarif narrated to us. He said: Jasr narrated to us. He said: al-Nu'man b. Abi Bakr b. Anas narrated to us, from Anas b. Malik, who said:
entries.matn_en: He went out to a funeral and prayed two light rak'as, then reclined beside a grave, and Anas dozed off. The occupant of the grave came out to him and said: It is as though you made light of your two rak'as just now. Our being able to do the like of them would be dearer to us than such-and-such. You act and do not know, whereas we know and are unable to act.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جَسْرٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «ابْنَ آدَمَ، طَإِ الْأَرْضَ بِقَدَمِكَ، فَإِنَّهَا عَنْ قَلِيلٍ قَبْرُكَ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا زِلْتَ فِي هَدْمِ عُمُرِكَ مُنْذُ سَقَطْتَ مِنْ بَطْنِ أُمِّكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Tarif narrated to us. He said: Jasr narrated to us, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Son of Adam, tread the earth with your foot, for before long it will be your grave. By God, you have not ceased demolishing your lifespan since you fell from your mother’s womb.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ طَرِيفٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 38⦘ جَسْرٌ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ الْحَسَنُ إِلَى جَانِبِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو فِي الْمَقْصُورَةِ، وَالنَّضْرُ أَمِيرُ الْبَصْرَةِ، فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ: أَدْرَكْتُ صَدْرَ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ يَنَامُونَ عَلَى أَطْرَافِهِمْ، يَفْتَرِشُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ، قَدْ جَرَتْ دُمُوعُهُمْ عَلَى خُدُودِهِمْ، يُنَاجُونَ رَبَّهُمْ فِي فَكَاكِ أَرْقَابِهِمْ، فَإِذَا عَمِلُوا سَيِّئَةً سَاءَتْهُمْ وَأَحْزَنَتْهُمْ، وَدَعَوُا اللَّهَ أَنْ يَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ، فَوَاللَّهِ مَا سَلِمَ الْقَوْمُ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ وَمَا نَجَوْا إِلَّا بِالْمَغْفِرَةِ، ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى النَّضْرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو فَقَالَ لَهُ: فَأَصْبَحْتَ وَاللَّهِ مُخَالِفًا لِلْقَوْمِ فِي الْعَمَلِ وَالسِّيرَةِ، فَإِيَّاكَ أَنْ تَرْجَحَ فِي الْأَمَانِيِّ فَمَا أَبْعَدَ صِفَتَكَ مِنْ صِفَةِ الْقَوْمِ، وَإِنَّ أَخَاكَ مَنْ نَصَحَكَ، وَمَنْ نَصَحَكَ خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِمَّنْ يَغُرُّكَ وَيُمَنِّيكَ، النَّجَا النَّجَا، الْوَحَا الْوَحَا، أَنْتُمْ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ عَلَى مَا تُعَرِّجُونَ، فَقَطِّعُوا عَنْكُمْ حِبَالَ الدُّنْيَا، وَغَلِّقُوا عَنْكُمْ أَبْوَابَهَا، كَأَنَّكُمْ رَكْبٌ وُقُوفٌ، إِذَا دُعِيَ أَحَدُكُمْ أَجَابَ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Tarif narrated to us. He said: [p. 38] Jasr narrated to us. He said:
entries.matn_en: Al-Hasan was beside al-Nadr b. 'Amr in the enclosure (maqsura), and al-Nadr was the governor of Basra. Al-Hasan said: I met the foremost of this community; they would sleep on their sides, spreading out their faces, their tears running down their cheeks, whispering to their Lord for the freeing of their necks. When they committed a wrong act it distressed and grieved them, and they asked God to forgive them. By God, the people were not free of sins, and they escaped only through forgiveness. Then he turned to al-Nadr b. 'Amr and said to him: By God, you have come to differ from those people in deed and in conduct, so beware of leaning toward wishful hopes, for how far your description is from theirs. Your true brother is the one who gives you sincere advice, and one who advises you is better for you than one who deceives you and fills you with hopes. Flee, flee! Hasten, hasten! By the Lord of the Ka'ba, you are lingering on [the way]; so cut off from yourselves the ropes of the world and bolt its doors against you, as though you were a riding party standing still: when one of you is called, he answers.

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأُوَيْسِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ: «كَانَ فِرَاشُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَدَمٍ حَشْوُهُ لِيفٌ» . ⦗ص: 39⦘ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأُوَيْسِيُّ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، نَحْوَهُ
entries.matn_en: [14] Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Uwaysi narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abi al-Zinad narrated to us, from Hisham b. 'Urwa, from his father, from 'A'isha, who said: “The bedding of the Messenger of God ﷺ was of tanned leather stuffed with palm fibre.” [p. 39] [14] Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Uwaysi narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abi al-Zinad narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from 'A'isha, the like of it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأُوَيْسِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ وَلَدِ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " حَضَرَ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ رَجُلًا يَمُوتُ، فَشَقَّ أَعْضَاءَهُ فَلَمْ يَجِدْهُ عَمِلَ خَيْرًا، ثُمَّ شَقَّ قَلْبَهُ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ فِيهِ خَيْرًا، ثُمَّ فَكَّ لَحْيَيْهِ فَوَجَدَ طَرَفَ لِسَانِهِ لَاصِقًا بِحَنَكِهِ، يَقُولُ: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ. قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم: ⦗ص: 40⦘ «فَغُفِرَ لَهُ بِكَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلَاصِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Uwaysi narrated to us. He said: Ibn Abi al-Zinad narrated to us, from Musa b. 'Uqba, from a man of the descendants of 'Ubada b. al-Samit, from Abu Hurayra, that the Prophet ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “The Angel of Death attended a man who was dying. He split open his limbs and found that he had done no good; then he split open his heart and found no good in it; then he unfastened his jaws and found the tip of his tongue stuck to his palate, saying: There is no god but God.” The Prophet ﷺ said: [p. 40] “So he was forgiven through the word of sincerity (kalimat al-ikhlas).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: " أَمَرَ اللَّهُ عز وجل بِعَبْدٍ إِلَى النَّارِ، فَلَمَّا وَقَفَ عَلَى شَفَتِهَا الْتَفَتَ فَقَالَ: أَمَا وَاللَّهِ يَا رَبِّ إِنْ كَانَ ظَنِّي بِكَ لَحَسَنٌ، قَالَ اللَّهُ عز وجل: رُدُّوهُ، فَأَنَا عِنْدَ حُسْنِ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، فَأُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ "
entries.isnad_en: And the Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “God, Mighty and Majestic, commanded that a servant be taken to the Fire. When he stood at its lip he turned and said: By God, my Lord, my opinion of You was surely a good one! God, Mighty and Majestic, said: Bring him back, for I am [as] My servant thinks of Me. So he was admitted to Paradise.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْأُوَيْسِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلَالٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ مُؤْمِنٍ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ عَيْنِهِ دُمُوعٌ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ، وَإِنْ كَانَ مِثْلَ رَأْسِ الذُّبَابِ، فَتُصِيبُ شَيْئًا، إِلَّا حَرَّمَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّارِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Uwaysi narrated to us. He said: Sulayman b. Bilal narrated to us, from Muhammad b. Abi Humayd, from 'Awn b. 'Abd Allah, from his father, from 'Abd Allah b. Mas'ud, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
entries.matn_en: “There is no believing servant from whose eye tears come out from fear of God—even if as small as the head of a fly—and they strike something, but God forbids him to the Fire.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَرَ الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ: "
entries.matn_ar: {أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَانِتٌ آنَاءَ اللَّيْلِ} [الزمر: 9] ، قَالَ: سَاعَاتِ اللَّيْلِ، أَوَّلَهُ وَآخِرَهُ وَأَوْسَطَهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Abu 'Umar al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: al-Mubarak b. Fadala narrated to us, from al-Hasan:
entries.matn_en: {Is he who is devoutly obedient (qanit) during the hours of the night} [Q. 39:9]. He said: “The hours of the night: its beginning, its end and its middle.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {وَتَأْكُلُونَ التُّرَاثَ} [الفجر: 19] ، قَالَ: «التُّرَاثُ نَصِيبُهُ وَنَصِيبُ صَاحِبِهِ، حَلَالُهُ وَحَرَامُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {And you devour the inheritance (al-turath)} [Q. 89:19]. He said: “The inheritance: his share and the share of his companion, its lawful and its unlawful.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {فَلَوْلَا أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ الْمُسَبِّحِينَ} [الصافات: 143] ، قَالَ: «لَوْلَا أَنَّهُ قَدَّمَ عَمَلًا صَالِحًا لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {Had he not been one of those who glorify [God]} [Q. 37:143]. He said: “Had he not put forward a righteous deed, he would have remained in its belly.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {كَذَلِكَ نَبْلُوهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوا يَفْسُقُونَ} [الأعراف: 163] ، قَالَ: «بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْمَعَاصِي»
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {Thus We test them for their disobedience (yafsuqun)} [Q. 7:163]. He said: “For the acts of disobedience they used to commit before that.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {اللُّؤْلُؤُ وَالْمَرْجَانُ} [الرحمن: 22] ، قَالَ: " اللُّؤْلُؤُ: الْعِظَامُ، وَالْمَرْجَانُ: الصِّغَارُ "
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {Pearl and coral (al-lu'lu' wa-l-marjan)} [Q. 55:22]. He said: “The pearl: the large ones; and the coral: the small ones.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {وَإِذَا أَرَدْنَا أَنْ نُهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا} [الإسراء: 16] ، قَالَ: " كَانَ أَهْلُ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ إِذَا كَثُرَ الْقَوْمُ قَالُوا: أَمَرَ بَنُو فُلَانٍ "
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {And when We intend to destroy a town, We command its affluent (amarna mutrafiha)} [Q. 17:16]. He said: “In the Jahiliyya, when a people became numerous, they would say: Banu so-and-so have become numerous (amira).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {وَإِنَّا لَجَاعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيْهَا صَعِيدًا جُرُزًا} [الكهف: 8] ، قَالَ: لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ "
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {And We will surely make what is on it barren dust (sa'idan juruzan)} [Q. 18:8]. He said: Nothing is on it.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحًا} [التحريم: 8] ، قَالَ: «يَتْرُكُ الذَّنْبَ ثُمَّ لَا يَعُودُ إِلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {Repent to God with sincere repentance (tawbatan nasuhan)} [Q. 66:8]. He said: “That he leaves the sin and then does not return to it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {وَكُلَّ إِنْسَانٍ أَلْزَمْنَاهُ طَائِرَهُ فِي عُنُقِهِ} [الإسراء: 13] ، قَالَ: «عَمَلُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {And every human being, We have fastened his fate (ta'irahu) to his neck} [Q. 17:13]. He said: “His deed.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {لَأَوَّاهٌ} [التوبة: 114] قَالَ: «الرَّحِيمُ بِعِبَادِ اللَّهِ»
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {Surely tender-hearted (la-awwah)} [Q. 9:114]. He said: “The one who is merciful to God’s servants.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ} [الحاقة: 23] ، قَالَ: «تَدْنُو مِنْهُ حَتَّى يَتَنَاوَلَهَا مِنْ حَيْثُ شَاءَ»
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {Its fruits are within reach (qutufuha daniya)} [Q. 69:23]. He said: “They come near to him until he takes them from wherever he wishes.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {وَمِنْ وَرَائِهِمْ بَرْزَخٌ إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ} [المؤمنون: 100] ، قَالَ: «الْقُبُورُ»
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {And behind them is a barrier (barzakh) until the day they are resurrected} [Q. 23:100]. He said: “The graves.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {فَهَلْ يَنْتَظِرُونَ إِلَّا مِثْلَ أَيَّامِ الَّذِينَ خَلَوْا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ} [يونس: 102] ، قَالَ: " خُوِّفُوا بِالْعَذَابِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: {بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَى وَأَمَرُّ} [القمر: 46] "
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {Then do they wait for anything but the like of the days of those who passed away before them?} [Q. 10:102]. He said: “They were threatened with punishment.” Then he said: {Rather, the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour is more calamitous and more bitter} [Q. 54:46].

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {ذَرَأْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ} [الأعراف: 179] ، قَالَ: «خَلَقْنَا لِجَهَنَّمَ»
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {We have created for Jahannam (dhara'na li-Jahannam)} [Q. 7:179]. He said: “We created for Jahannam.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {فَلَمَّا آسَفُونَا} [الزخرف: 55] ، قَالَ: «أَغْضَبُونَا»
entries.isnad_en: And concerning his saying:
entries.matn_en: {So when they vexed Us (asafuna)} [Q. 43:55]. He said: “They angered Us.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَرَ الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: ⦗ص: 43⦘ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التُّسْتَرِيُّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِلَا إِنَّ مَطْعَمَ ابْنِ آدَمَ ضُرِبَ مَثَلًا لِلدُّنْيَا، أَلَا وَإِنْ قَزَّحَهُ وَمَلَّحَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Abu 'Umar al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: [p. 43] Yazid b. Ibrahim al-Tustari narrated to us. He said: I heard al-Hasan relating from Ubayy b. Ka'b, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Beware: the food of the son of Adam has been made a parable for the world—even if he seasons it with spices and salts it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: لَمَّا حَضَرَ سَلْمَانَ الْمَوْتُ بَكَى، فَقِيلَ لَهُ: مَا يُبْكِيكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: " أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَا أَبْكِي جَزَعًا عَلَى الْمَوْتِ وَلَا حِرْصًا، وَلَكِنْ إِنَّمَا أَبْكِي لِأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَهِدَ إِلَيْنَا فَقَالَ: «يَكْفِي أَحَدَكُمْ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا كَزَادِ الرَّاكِبِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Yazid narrated to us. He said: I heard al-Hasan say: When death came to Salman he wept. He was asked: What makes you weep, Abu 'Abd Allah? He said:
entries.matn_en: “By God, I do not weep out of dread of death or out of eagerness [for the world], but I weep only because the Messenger of God ﷺ made a covenant with us and said: ‘It suffices one of you of the world to have the like of a rider’s provision.’”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 47⦘ يَزِيدُ، قَالَ: وَسَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ: «ابْنَ آدَمَ، اعْمَلْ كَأَنَّكَ تَرَاهُ، وَاعْدُدْ نَفْسَكَ فِي الْمَوْتَى، وَاتَّقِ دَعْوَةَ الْمَظْلُومِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: [p. 47] Yazid narrated to us. He said: And I heard al-Hasan say: Abu al-Darda' said:
entries.matn_en: “Son of Adam, act as though you see Him, count yourself among the dead, and beware the supplication of the wronged.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: قَالَ الْحَسَنُ: وَقَالَ أَبُو الدَّرْدَاءِ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَنْ لَمْ يَعْرِفْ نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا فِي مَطْعَمِهِ وَمَشْرَبِهِ، فَقَدْ قَلَّ عَمَلُهُ، وَحَضَرَ عَذَابُهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Al-Hasan said: And Abu al-Darda' said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever knows God’s favour upon him only in his food and drink has few deeds, and his punishment is present.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ ⦗ص: 48⦘ طَهْمَانَ، قَالَ أَبُو حَاتِمٍ: هُوَ الْمُعْتَمِرُ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «خِيَارُكُمْ يَذْهَبُونَ، وَأَنْتُمْ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ تَرْذُلُونَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Yazid b. [p. 48] Tahman narrated to us—Abu Hatim said: He is al-Mu'tamir—he said: I heard al-Hasan say:
entries.matn_en: “The best of you are going away, while you become baser every day.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ أَبُو حَاتِمٍ: شَيْخٌ قَدِيمٌ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ نَسِيٍّ، أَنَّهُ بَلَغَهُ: " أَنَّ مُوسَى عليه السلام حَجَّ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ حَمْرَاءَ، وَأَنَّ عِيسَى عليه السلام حَجَّ عَلَى رَاحِلَتِهِ، أَوْ عَلَى ثَوْرٍ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: al-Dahhak b. Yasar narrated to us—Abu Hatim said: an old shaykh—from 'Ubada b. Nusayy, that it had reached him:
entries.matn_en: That Moses (a) performed the pilgrimage on a red she-camel, and that Jesus (a) performed the pilgrimage on his riding beast, or on a bull.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَرَ الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُنْذِرُ بْنُ ثَعْلَبَةَ، عَنْ حَوْشَبٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «إِنَّ الْقَلْبَ لَأَشَدُّ طَيْرُورَةً مِنَ الرِّيشَةِ فِي يَوْمٍ عَاصِفٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Abu 'Umar al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: al-Mundhir b. Tha'laba narrated to us, from Hawshab, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The heart is more apt to flutter than a feather on a stormy day.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {حُورٌ مَقْصُورَاتٌ فِي الْخِيَامِ} [الرحمن: 72] ، قَالَ: «دُرٌّ مُجَوَّفٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Shu'ba narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Malik b. Maysara, from Abu al-Ahwas, from 'Abd Allah:
entries.matn_en: {Houris (hur) secluded in pavilions} [Q. 55:72]. He said: “A hollow pearl.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَمْ مِنْ يَدٍ ⦗ص: 49⦘ فَاجِرَةٍ قَدْ هَمَّتْ، فَمَنَعَهَا اللَّهُ وَكَفَّهَا» حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: هَذَا مِنْ غُرَرِ الْحَدِيثِ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Hammad b. Zayd narrated to us, from Hisham b. Hassan, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: “How many a wicked hand [p. 49] has intended [harm], and God has prevented it and held it back!” Abu Hatim narrated to us; he said: This is among the choicest sayings (ghurar) of hadith.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُمَرَ الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: {أَنْكَالًا} [المزمل: 12] قَالَ: «الْقُيُودُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Abu 'Umar al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: al-Mubarak narrated to us, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: {Fetters (ankal)} [Q. 73:12]. He said: “Shackles (al-quyud).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامُ بْنُ مِسْكِينٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَرَأَ الْحَسَنُ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ: {لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا} [الإسراء: 62] ، قَالَ: «حِينَ رَامَ آدَمُ فَصَرَعَهُ تِلْكَ الصَّرْعَةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Sallam b. Miskin narrated to us. He said: Al-Hasan recited this verse:
entries.matn_en: {I will surely seize his descendants (la-ahtanikanna), except a few} [Q. 17:62]. He said: “When Adam sought [it], and he threw him down with that throw.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، عَنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ:
entries.matn_ar: {مُتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَى الْأَرَائِكِ} [الكهف: 31] قَالَ: «الْأَسِرَّةُ فِي الْحِجَالِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us, from al-Mubarak, from al-Hasan:
entries.matn_en: {Reclining therein on couches (ara'ik)} [Q. 18:31]. He said: “Beds within canopies (hijal).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، عَنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانُوا يَقُولُونَ: يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، إِنَّا لَنُحِبُّ اللَّهَ، فَأَرَادَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَجْعَلَ لِحُبِّهِمْ إِيَّاهُ عِلْمًا، فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عز وجل: {إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ اللَّهَ فَاتَّبَعُونِي} [آل عمران: 31] الْآيَةَ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us, from al-Mubarak, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: They used to say: O Messenger of God, we do love God. So God wished to make a sign ('ilm) for their love of Him, and God, Mighty and Majestic, sent down: {If you love God, then follow me} [Q. 3:31]—the verse [continues].

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مِنْ خِصَالِ الْمُنَافِقِ: يُحِبُّ الْمَدْحَ، وَيَكْرَهُ الذَّمَّ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Shu'ba narrated to us, from 'Awf, from a man, from Wahb b. Munabbih, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Among the traits of the hypocrite: he loves praise and dislikes blame.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ شَرْقِيٍّ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ عِكْرِمَةَ:
entries.matn_ar: {يَعْلَمُونَ ظَاهِرًا مِنَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا} [الروم: 7] ، قَالَ: «الْأَعْمَالُ» وَذَكَرَ السِّرَاجَ وَنَحْوَهُ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Shu'ba narrated to us, from Sharqi, who said: I heard 'Ikrima [say]:
entries.matn_en: {They know what is apparent of the life of this world} [Q. 30:7]. He said: “Deeds.” And he mentioned the lamp and the like.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الْأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، ⦗ص: 51⦘ عَنْ أَبِي الْأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا كَانَ مِنْ نَظْرَةٍ فَإِنَّ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيهَا مَطْمَعًا»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Abu 'Awana narrated to us, from Sulayman al-A'mash, from Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. Yazid, [p. 51] from Abu al-Ahwas, from 'Abd Allah, who said:
entries.matn_en: “No glance occurs but that Satan has a place of hope in it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا صَالِحٌ أَبُو خُزَيْمَةَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " {ذَلِكَ مَا كُنْتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ} [ق: 19] ، قَالَ: «فَاسِقٌ فِي الْحَيَاةِ، مُفْسِدٌ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Salih Abu Khuzayma narrated to us. He said: I heard al-Hasan say:
entries.matn_en: {That is what you were trying to avoid (tahid)} [Q. 50:19]. He said: “A sinner in life, a corrupter at death.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ كُرْدُوسِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو،
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ أَبُو حَاتِمٍ: كُرْدُوسٌ هُوَ أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، وَكَانَ يَقْرَأُ الْكُتُبَ، قَالَ: يَجِدُهُ فِيمَا يَقْرَأُ مِنَ الْكُتُبِ: «إِنَّ اللَّهَ تبارك وتعالى لَيَبْتَلِي الْعَبْدَ وَهُوَ يُحِبُّهُ؛ لِيَسْمَعَ تَضَرُّعَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Shu'ba narrated to us, from 'Amr b. Murra, from Abu Wa'il, from Kurdus b. 'Amr—Abu Hatim said: Kurdus is Abu Nu'aym, and he used to read the books—he said: He finds it in what he reads of the books:
entries.matn_en: “God, Blessed and Exalted, tests the servant while He loves him, in order to hear his entreaty (tadarru').”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: نُبِّئْتُ، أَنَّ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَنْصَارِ كَانَ إِذَا حَضَرَ الصَّلَاةَ قَالَ: «تَوَضَّئُوا؛ فَإِنَّ بَعْضَ مَا تَقُولُونَ أَشَدُّ مِنَ الْحَدَثِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Yazid b. Ibrahim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Sirin narrated to us. He said: I was informed:
entries.matn_en: That a man of the Ansar used to say, when the time of prayer came: “Perform ablution; for some of what you say is worse than [ritual] impurity (hadath).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ⦗ص: 52⦘ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي تَمِيمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: {فَنَادَوْا وَلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ} [ص: 3] ، قَالَ: «حِينَ لَا نَزْوَ، وَلَا فِرَارَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Shu'ba narrated to us, [p. 52] from Abu Ishaq, from a man of Banu Tamim, from Ibn 'Abbas, concerning His saying:
entries.matn_en: {So they called out, though it was no time for escape (wa-lata hina manas)} [Q. 38:3]. He said: “When there is no leaping and no fleeing.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: وَفِي قَوْلِهِ:
entries.matn_ar: {وَأَنَّى لَهُمُ التَّنَاوُشُ} [سبأ: 52] ، قَالَ: «الرَّدُّ»
entries.isnad_en: And concerning His saying:
entries.matn_en: {And how can they have the attaining (al-tanawush)} [Q. 34:52]. He said: “The return (al-radd).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُبَارَكُ بْنُ فَضَالَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ قَالَ، يَعْنِي الرَّبَّ تبارك وتعالى: «يَخْرُجُ مِنَ النَّارِ مَنْ ذَكَرَنِي يَوْمًا، أَوْ خَافَنِي فِي مَقَامٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: al-Mubarak b. Fadala narrated to us, from 'Ubayd Allah b. Abi Bakr, from Anas, from the Prophet ﷺ, that he said—meaning the Lord, Blessed and Exalted:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever has remembered Me for a day, or feared Me in a [standing] place, will come out of the Fire.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَوْضِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ بَكْرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيَّ
entries.matn_ar: يُحَدِّثُ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً مِنْ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ كَانَتْ تَقُولُ إِذَا أَصْبَحَتْ: " يَا نَفْسُ، الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُكَ، لَا يَوْمَ لَكِ غَيْرَهُ، فَتَعْمَلُ فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تَعْمَلَ، فَإِذَا أَمْسَتْ ⦗ص: 53⦘ قَالَتْ: يَا نَفْسُ، اللَّيْلَةُ لَيْلَتُكِ، لَا لَيْلَةَ لَكِ غَيْرَهَا، فَتَعْمَلُ فِي تِلْكَ اللَّيْلَةِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تَعْمَلَ حَتَّى تُصْبِحَ. فَلَمْ يَزَلْ ذَلِكَ دَأْبُهَا حَتَّى مَضَتْ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hawdi narrated to us. He said: Yazid b. Ibrahim narrated to us. He said: I heard Bakr b. 'Abd Allah al-Muzani relate:
entries.matn_en: That a woman of the people of Yemen used to say, when morning came: “O soul, today is your day; you have no day other than it; so do in this day what God wills you to do.” And when evening came, [p. 53] she would say: “O soul, tonight is your night; you have no night other than it; so do in this night what God wills you to do until morning.” This remained her practice until she passed away.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ خَتَنِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ زَائِدَةَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ سُفْيَانُ الثَّوْرِيُّ: «جَنِّبْ قَلْبَكَ الرِّيَبَ وَمَا تَخْشَى فَسَادَهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Ibrahim b. Khalid narrated to us, from 'Abd al-'Aziz, the son-in-law of 'Uthman b. Za'ida, who said: Sufyan al-Thawri said:
entries.matn_en: “Keep your heart away from doubts and from what you fear will corrupt it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " بَلَغَنِي أَنَّ أَبْوَابَ السَّمَاءِ تُفْتَحُ لِلرَّجُلِ لَيْلَةَ الْمِلَاكِ، يُقَالُ لَهُ: أَرَادَ التَّعَفُّفَ عَمَّا حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Haywa b. Shurayh narrated to me. He said: Isma'il b. 'Ayyash narrated to us, from Yahya b. Sa'id al-Ansari, who said:
entries.matn_en: “It has reached me that the doors of heaven are opened for a man on the night of the wedding (laylat al-milak); it is said of him: He desired to abstain from what God has forbidden.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ ابْنِ بَهْدَلَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ: {لَابِثِينَ فِيهَا أَحْقَابًا} [النبأ: 23] ، قَالَ: «الْحُقْبُ ثَمَانُونَ عَامًا»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba b. Khalid narrated to us. He said: Hammad b. Salama narrated to us, from 'Asim b. Bahdala, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayra, concerning this verse:
entries.matn_en: {Abiding therein for ages (ahqab)} [Q. 78:23]. He said: “The huqb is eighty years.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ⦗ص: 54⦘ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْمَشْهُودُ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَالْمَوْعُودُ يَوْمُ الْقِيَامَةِ، وَقَرَأَ: {ذَلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَجْمُوعٌ لَهُ النَّاسُ، وَذَلِكَ يَوْمٌ مَشْهُودٌ} [هود: 103] "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Hammad narrated to us, from [p. 54] 'Ammar b. Abi 'Ammar, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said:
entries.matn_en: “‘The witnessed’ is the Day of Resurrection, and ‘the promised’ is the Day of Resurrection.” And he recited: {That is a Day for which mankind will be gathered, and that is a Day witnessed} [Q. 11:103].

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ:
entries.matn_ar: {فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًا} [طه: 108] ، قَالَ: هَمْسَ أَقْدَامِهِمْ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Hammad narrated to us, from Humayd, from al-Hasan:
entries.matn_en: {And you will hear nothing but a faint sound (hams)} [Q. 20:108]. He said: The faint sound of their footsteps.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى،
entries.matn_ar: فِي هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ: {قَالُوا يَا وَيْلَنَا مَنْ بَعَثَنَا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنَا} [يس: 52] الْآيَةَ: يَقُولُ الْكَافِرُ: {يَا وَيْلَنَا مَنْ بَعَثَنَا مِنْ مَرْقَدِنَا} [يس: 52] ، وَيَقُولُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ: {هَذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحْمَنُ وَصَدَقَ الْمُرْسَلُونَ} [يس: 52]
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Hammad narrated to us, from Thabit, from 'Abd al-Rahman b. Abi Layla, concerning this verse:
entries.matn_en: {They will say: Woe to us! Who has raised us from our resting place?} [Q. 36:52]—the verse [continues]: The unbeliever says: {Woe to us! Who has raised us from our resting place?} [Q. 36:52], and the believers say: {This is what the Most Merciful promised, and the messengers spoke the truth} [Q. 36:52].

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ:
entries.matn_ar: {وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ} [ق: 16] ، قَالَ: «نِيَاطُ الْقَلْبِ وَمَا حَمَلَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Hammad narrated to us, from 'Ata', from Sa'id b. Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas:
entries.matn_en: {And We are nearer to him than the jugular vein (habl al-warid)} [Q. 50:16]. He said: “The cord (niyat) of the heart and what it carries.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ ⦗ص: 55⦘ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، عَنْ أَبِي عِيَاضٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا قَرَأَ: {فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جِئْنَا مِنْ كُلِّ أُمَّةٍ بِشَهِيدٍ وَجِئْنَا بِكَ عَلَى هَؤُلَاءِ شَهِيدًا} [النساء: 41] بَكَى
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Hammad narrated to us, from [p. 55] 'Ata' b. al-Sa'ib, from Abu 'Iyad:
entries.matn_en: That the Messenger of God ﷺ used to weep whenever he recited: {How then will it be when We bring from every nation a witness, and bring you as a witness over these?} [Q. 4:41]

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَفْرَحُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ بِالشِّتَاءِ: أَنَّ لَيْلَهُ طَوِيلٌ يَقُومُهُ، وَأَنَّ نَهَارَهُ قَصِيرٌ يَصُومُهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Hammam narrated to us, from Qatada, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: “It has reached us that the angels rejoice for the believer in winter: that its night is long and he stands in prayer through it, and that its day is short and he fasts through it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَزْمٌ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ دِينَارٍ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَأَنَا لِلْقَارِئِ الْفَاجِرِ أَخْوَفُ مِنِّي مِنَ الْفَاجِرِ الْمُبْرِزِ بِفُجُورِهِ، إِنَّ هَذَا أَبْعَدُهُمَا غَوْرًا»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Hazm narrated to us. He said: I heard Malik b. Dinar say:
entries.matn_en: “I fear more for the sinful reciter (qari') than I fear for the sinner who flaunts his sinning; for this one is the deeper of the two in his depths.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سَلَّامٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي مُطِيعٍ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَيُّوبَ السِّخْتِيَانِيَّ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا خَبِيثَ أَخْبَثُ مِنْ قَارِئٍ فَاجِرٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Sallam, meaning Ibn Abi Muti', narrated to us. He said: I heard Ayyub al-Sakhtiyani say:
entries.matn_en: “There is no wicked one more wicked than a sinful reciter.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَزْمٌ، قَالَ: دَخَلْنَا عَلَى مَالِكِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ وَهُوَ يَكِيدُ بِنَفْسِهِ، فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي ⦗ص: 57⦘ لَمْ أُحِبَّ الْبَقَاءَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لِبَطْنٍ وَلَا لِفَرْجٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Hazm narrated to us. He said: We went in to see Malik b. Dinar during the illness in which he died, while he was in the throes of death (yakidu bi-nafsihi); he raised his head to heaven, then said:
entries.matn_en: “O God, You know that I [p. 57] did not love remaining in the world for the sake of a belly or a private part.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَزْمٌ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مَالِكَ بْنَ دِينَارٍ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " فِي زَمَانٍ أَشْهَبَ لَا يُبْصِرُ، وَمَا بِكُمْ إِلَّا الْبَصِيرُ، إِنَّكُمْ فِي زَمَانٍ كَثِيرٌ تَفَاخُرُهُمْ، أَوْ قَالَ: تَعَاجُبُهُمْ، قَدِ انْتَفَخَتْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ فِي أَفْوَاهِهِمْ، وَطَلَبُوا الدُّنْيَا بِعَمَلِ الْآخِرَةِ، فَاحْذَرُوهُمْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ، لَا يُوقِعُوكُمْ فِي شَبَكَاتِهِمْ، يَا عَالِمُ، أَنْتَ عَالِمٌ تَفْخَرُ بِعِلْمِكَ ، يَا عَالِمٌ أَنْتَ عَالِمٌ تَأْكُلُ بِعِلْمِكَ ، يَا عَالِمٌ أَنْتَ عَالِمٌ تَسْتَطِيلُ بِعِلْمِكَ ، يَا عَالِمٌ أَنْتَ عَالِمٌ تُكَاثِرُ بِعِلْمِكَ، لَوْ كَانَ هَذَا الْعِلْمُ طَلَبْتَهُ لِلَّهِ لَرُئِيَ ذَلِكَ فِيكَ وَفِي عَمَلِكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Hazm narrated to us. He said: I heard Malik b. Dinar say:
entries.matn_en: “In a murky (ashhab) time that does not see—and none of you is anything but sighted—you are in a time whose people boast greatly—or he said: admire themselves greatly; their tongues are swollen in their mouths, and they seek the world through the deeds of the hereafter. So beware of them for yourselves, lest they entangle you in their nets. O scholar, you are a scholar who boasts of his knowledge; O scholar, you are a scholar who eats by his knowledge; O scholar, you are a scholar who lords it over others with his knowledge; O scholar, you are a scholar who vies for increase through his knowledge. If you had sought this knowledge for God’s sake, that would be seen in you and in your deeds.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَقِيلٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَتَّابٍ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ حَبَّانَ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ بِشْرِ بْنِ رَافِعٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " قَالَ لُقْمَانُ لِابْنِهِ: يَا بُنَيَّ، اتَّخِذْ أَلْفَ صَدِيقٍ؛ فَإِنَّهُ قَلِيلٌ، وَلَا تَتَّخِذَنَّ عَدُوًّا؛ فَإِنَّهُ كَثِيرٌ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Abu 'Aqil narrated to us. He said: Abu 'Attab Ishaq b. Ibrahim narrated to us, from Habban b. 'Ali, from Bishr b. Rafi', who said:
entries.matn_en: “Luqman said to his son: My son, take a thousand friends, for that is still few; and do not take [even one] enemy, for that is many.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَخْرٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: دَخَلْنَا عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ نَعُودُهُ، قَالَ: فَذَهَبْنَا نُرَجِّيهِ، فَقَالَ: «أَنَا لَا أَرْجُوهُ وَقَدْ صُمْتُ ثَمَانِينَ رَمَضَانًا ؟»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. 'Abd Allah b. Sakhr narrated to us. He said: Hammad b. Zayd narrated to us, from 'Ata' b. al-Sa'ib, who said:
entries.matn_en: We went in to see Abu 'Abd al-Rahman al-Sulami, visiting him in his illness. He said: We set about giving him hope, and he said: “I do not hope for Him—and I have fasted eighty Ramadans?”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ صَخْرٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمُ بْنُ أَخْضَرَ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُدَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مِجْلَزٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَا يَزَالُ الْعَبْدُ فِي تَوْبَةٍ مَا لَمْ يُعَايِنِ الْمَلَكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Sakhr narrated to us. He said: Sulaym b. Akhdar informed us, from 'Imran b. Hudayr, from Abu Mijlaz, who said:
entries.matn_en: “The servant remains in [a state of] repentance as long as he has not beheld the angel.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ صَخْرٍ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا ⦗ص: 59⦘ مِسْكِينٌ أَبُو فَاطِمَةَ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا حَوْشَبٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: {ثُمَّ يَتُوبُونَ مِنْ قَرِيبٍ} [النساء: 17] ، قَالَ: «مَا لَمْ يُغَرْغِرْ بِالْحَيَاةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Sakhr narrated to us. He said: [p. 59] Miskin Abu Fatima informed us. He said: Hawshab informed us, from al-Hasan, who said:
entries.matn_en: {Then they repent soon after (min qarib)} [Q. 4:17]. He said: “As long as he is not yet gurgling in his life (ma lam yughargir).”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ صَخْرٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ:
entries.matn_ar: {نَنْقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَا} [الرعد: 41] ، قَالَ: «الْمَوْتُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Sakhr narrated to us, from Yazid b. Zuray', from Abu Raja', from al-Hasan:
entries.matn_en: {We diminish it from its edges (atrafiha)} [Q. 13:41]. He said: “Death.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ صَخْرٍ، عَنْ مُعْتَمِرٍ، عَنْ شَبِيبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ مُقَاتِلَ بْنَ حَيَّانَ،
entries.matn_ar: يَقُولُ فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تبارك وتعالى: {سِيمَاهُمْ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ مِنْ أَثَرِ السُّجُودِ} [الفتح: 29] ، قَالَ: " بَيَاضٌ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Ibn Sakhr narrated to us, from Mu'tamir, from Shabib b. 'Abd al-Malik, who said: I heard Muqatil b. Hayyan say, concerning the saying of God, Blessed and Exalted:
entries.matn_en: {Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration} [Q. 48:29]. He said: “A whiteness on their faces on the Day of Resurrection.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ ، قَالَ: أَخْبَرَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَمْرَضُ وَيَصِحُّ، فَلَمَّا مَرِضَ ⦗ص: 60⦘ مَرَضَهُ الَّذِي تُوُفِّيَ فِيهِ قَالَ: «مَا أَرَى هَذَا إِلَّا الَّذِي لَيْسَ اللَّهُ بِتَارِكٍ مِنْهُ أَحَدًا لِمُوَافَاةِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim said: Hudba informed us. He said: Sulayman b. al-Mughira narrated to us, from Thabit, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Prophet ﷺ would fall ill and recover; and when he fell ill [p. 60] with the illness in which he died, he said: “I do not see this except as that from which God will leave no one out, so that [all] may arrive at the Day of Resurrection.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: عَادَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرِيضًا، فَجَعَلَ يَصْرِفُ وَجْهَهُ عَنْهُ، فَإِذَا نَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ تَغَيَّرَ لَوْنُهُ، فَإِذَا صَرَفَ وَجْهَهُ تَغَيَّرَ لَوْنُهُ، قَالَ: «فَطِنْتُمْ لِي؟» قَالُوا: نَعَمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: «مَا مِنْهُ مِنْ عِرْقٍ إِلَّا يَأْلَمُ، وَلَقَدْ أَتَاهُ آتٍ مِنْ رَبِّهِ فَبَشَّرَهُ أَنَّهُ لَا أَدَبَ عَلَيْهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Sulayman narrated to us, from Thabit, who said:
entries.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ visited a sick man, and he kept turning his face away from him; when he looked at him his colour changed, and when he turned his face away his colour changed. He said: “Have you noticed me?” They said: Yes, O Messenger of God. He said: “There is no vein in him but it aches; and one has come to him from his Lord and given him the glad tidings that there is no ‘adab’ upon him.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ غَيْلَانَ بْنِ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ مُسْلِمُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ إِذَا صَلَّى كَأَنَّهُ ثَوْبٌ مُلْقًى، مِنْ قِلَّةِ الْتِفَاتِهِ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Sulayman narrated to us, from Ghaylan b. Jarir, who said:
entries.matn_en: Muslim b. Yasar, when he prayed, was like a garment cast down, from how little he turned about.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " بَلَغَنَا أَنَّ الرَّجُلَ يَتَّكِئُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ سَبْعِينَ سَنَةً، عِنْدَهُ مِنْ أَزْوَاجِهِ وَخَدَمِهِ وَمَا أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْكَرَامَةِ وَالنَّعِيمِ، فَإِذَا حَانَتْ مِنْهُ نَظْرَةٌ إِذَا أَزْوَاجٌ لَهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ رَآهُنَّ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ يَقُلْنَ: قَدْ آنَ لَكَ أَنْ ⦗ص: 61⦘ تَجْعَلَ لَنَا مِنْكَ نَصِيبًا "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Sulayman narrated to us, from Thabit, who said:
entries.matn_en: “It has reached us that a man will recline in Paradise for seventy years, with his wives and servants and the honour and delight God has given him; then, when a glance of his falls elsewhere, there are wives of his whom he had not seen before, saying: It is time for you [p. 61] to give us a share of yourself.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هُدْبَةُ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قِيلَ لَهُ: هَذَا الْمُؤْمِنُ يُشَدَّدُ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ، وَهَذَا الْكَافِرُ يُهَوَّنُ عَلَيْهِ عِنْدَ الْمَوْتِ؟ قَالَ: «أَفَلَا أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَنْ ذَلِكَ؟ إِنَّ الْمُؤْمِنَ يَبْقَى عَلَيْهِ ذُنُوبٌ لَيُكَافَأُ بِهَا عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ، وَإِنَّ الْكَافِرَ تَبْقَى لَهُ حَسَنَاتٌ فَيُجْزَى بِهَا عِنْدَ مَوْتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Hudba narrated to us. He said: Hammam narrated to us, from Qatada, from al-Hasan, that the Prophet ﷺ was told:
entries.matn_en: This believer has it made hard for him at death, while this unbeliever has it made easy for him at death? He said: “Shall I not tell you about that? The believer has sins remaining upon him for which he is repaid at his death; and the unbeliever has good deeds remaining to him, for which he is recompensed at his death.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مَحْبُوبِ بْنِ ⦗ص: 62⦘ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ هِلَالِ بْنِ أَبِي زَيْنَبَ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ الْمُخْتَارِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِابْنِ صَائِدٍ: «مَا تُرْبَةُ الْجَنَّةِ يَا ابْنَ صَائِدٍ؟» قَالَ: دَرْمَكَةٌ بَيْضَاءُ مِسْكٌ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ، قَالَ: «صَدَقَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: al-Hasan b. Mahbub b. [p. 62] al-Hasan b. Hilal b. Abi Zaynab narrated to us. He said: 'Abd al-'Aziz b. al-Mukhtar narrated to us. He said: Abu Maslama narrated to us, from Abu Nadra, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, that the Prophet ﷺ said to Ibn Sa'id:
entries.matn_en: “What is the soil of Paradise, Ibn Sa'id?” He said: White fine flour (darmaka), musk, O Abu al-Qasim. He said: “He has spoken truly.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تُمَيْلَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ: {اعْمَلُوا آلَ دَاوُدَ شُكْرًا} ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «الشُّكْرُ تَقْوَى اللَّهِ، وَالْعَمَلُ بِطَاعَتِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Sa'id b. al-Walid narrated to us. He said: Abu Tumayla narrated to us, from Musa b. 'Ubayda, from Muhammad b. Ka'b:
entries.matn_en: {Work, O family of David, in gratitude} [Q. 34:13]. He said: “Gratitude is God-fearing piety (taqwa) and acting in obedience to Him.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْقُطَعِيُّ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو تُمَيْلَةَ، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ وَاقِدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ النَّحْوِيِّ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ:
entries.matn_ar: {يَعْلَمُونَ ظَاهِرًا مِنَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا} [الروم: 7] قَالَ: مَتَى يَزْرَعُونَ، وَمَتَى يَغْرِسُونَ، وَمَتَى يَحْصُدُونَ ، وَأَشْبَاهَ ذَلِكَ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Abu Bakr al-Quta'i Muhammad b. Sa'id narrated to us. He said: Abu Tumayla narrated to us, from al-Husayn b. Waqid, from Yazid al-Nahwi, from 'Ikrima, from Ibn 'Abbas:
entries.matn_en: {They know what is apparent of the life of this world} [Q. 30:7]. He said: “[They know] when to sow, when to plant, when to reap, and the like.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ اللَّاحِقِيُّ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ بْنُ بَشِيرٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ:
entries.matn_ar: {يَعْلَمُونَ ظَاهِرًا مِنَ الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا} [الروم: 7] الْآيَةَ، فَقَالَ الْحَسَنُ: «وَاللَّهِ لَبَلَغَ مِنْ عِلْمِ أَحَدِهِمْ مِنْ دُنْيَاهُ أَنَّهُ يُقَلِّبُ الدِّرْهَمَ عَلَى ظُفْرِهِ يُخْبِرُكَ بِوَزْنِهِ، مَا يُحْسِنُ يُصَلِّي»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: 'Ali b. 'Uthman al-Lahiqi narrated to us. He said: Juwayriya b. Bashir narrated to us, from al-Hasan:
entries.matn_en: {They know what is apparent of the life of this world} [Q. 30:7]—the verse [continues]. Then al-Hasan said: “By God, the worldly knowledge of one of them reaches the point that he turns a dirham over on his fingernail and tells you its weight, [yet] he does not know how to pray properly.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَفْصٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ هُوَ أَبُو طُوَالَةَ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِهَدِيَّةٍ، فَطَلَبَ فِي الْبَيْتِ شَيْئًا يَضَعُهَا فِيهِ، فَلَمْ يَجِدْهُ، فَقَالَ: «ضَعْهَا بِالْحَضِيضِ، فَلَوْ كَانَتْ تَعْدِلُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ جَنَاحَ بَعُوضَةٍ مَا سَقَى مِنْهَا كَافِرًا شَرْبَةً»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Abu Hafs narrated to us. He said: Abu 'Asim narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. 'Umara b. 'Amr b. Hazm narrated to us, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Abd al-Rahman—he is Abu Tuwala—that the Prophet ﷺ was brought a gift, and he looked in the house for something to put it in, but did not find it. He said:
entries.matn_en: “Put it on the ground (al-hadid); for if it were worth to God the wing of a gnat, He would not have given a disbeliever a single drink from it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي ⦗ص: 64⦘ صَالِحُ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «لَئِنْ أُؤْتَمَنُ عَلَى بَيْتٍ مِنْ دُرٍّ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ مِنْ أَنْ أُؤْتَمَنَ عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ حَسْنَاءَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: [p. 64] Salih b. Musa narrated to me, from Mu'awiya b. Ishaq, from Sa'id b. Jubayr, who said:
entries.matn_en: “To be entrusted with a house of pearls is dearer to me than to be entrusted with a beautiful woman.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُحَيَّاةِ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَعْلَى، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قِيلَ لِأَبِي وَائِلٍ: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى خَارِجِيٍّ خَرَجَ عَلَى النَّاسِ فِي السُّوقِ، فَعَدَا عَلَيْهِ أَهْلُ السُّوقِ، فَضَرَبُوهُ بِالْكَرَاسِيِّ حَتَّى قَتَلُوهُ؟ فَقَالَ أَبُو وَائِلٍ: وَاللَّهِ مَا عَزَّ هَذَا لِلَّهِ دِينًا، وَلَا رَدَّ مَظْلِمَةَ مَظْلُومٍ، هَذَا وَأَبِيكَ الْحُسَيْنُ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: Abu al-Muhayyat Yahya b. Ya'la narrated to us, from 'Abd al-Malik b. 'Umayr, who said:
entries.matn_en: Abu Wa'il was told: Have you not seen the Khariji who came out against the people in the market, so the people of the market rushed upon him and struck him with chairs until they killed him? Abu Wa'il said: “By God, this man neither strengthened any religion for God nor redressed the grievance of any wronged person. This one, by your father, is al-Husayn.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الْمُحَيَّاةِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: قَالَ رَجُلٌ لِابْنِهِ: «يَا بُنَيَّ، أَظْهِرِ الْإِيَاسَ مِمَّا عِنْدَ النَّاسِ؛ فَإِنَّهُ الْغِنَى، وَإِيَّاكَ وَطَلَبَ الْحَوَائِجِ إِلَيْهِمْ؛ فَإِنَّهُ فَقْرٌ حَاضِرٌ، وَإِذَا قُمْتَ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ فَأَحْسِنِ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ صَلَاةَ مُوَدِّعٍ، فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ الْيَوْمَ خَيْرًا مِنْكَ أَمْسِ، وَغَدًا خَيْرًا مِنْكَ الْيَوْمَ، فَافْعَلْ، وَإِيَّاكَ وَمَا يُعْتَذَرُ مِنْهُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd b. Sa'id narrated to me. He said: Abu al-Muhayyat narrated to me, from 'Abd al-Malik b. 'Umayr, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man said to his son: “My son, show despair of what people have, for that is wealth; and beware of seeking your needs from them, for that is present poverty. When you stand to pray, perform the ablution well, then pray the prayer of one bidding farewell. If you are able to be better today than you were yesterday, and better tomorrow than you are today, then do so. And beware of anything for which one must apologize.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُطَّلِبُ ⦗ص: 66⦘ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَدَرِيَّةِ فَقَالَ: يَا أَبَا الْحُسَيْنِ، أَسْأَلُكَ عَنْ كَلِمَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ، قَالَ: أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ تبارك وتعالى أَنْ يُعْصَى؟ قَالَ زَيْدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ: فَعُصِيَ عَنْوَةً؟ قَالَ: فَاشْتَدَّ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ يَهْرُبُ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: al-Muttalib [p. 66]—meaning Ibn Ziyad—narrated to us, from Zayd b. 'Ali, who said:
entries.matn_en: A man of the Qadariyya came to him and said: O Abu al-Husayn, I ask you about one word. He said: “Did God love to be disobeyed?” Zayd b. 'Ali said: “Then was He disobeyed by force?” He said: And the man bolted from before him, fleeing.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَرْوَانَ الْبَصْرِيُّ، عَنْ كَثِيرٍ أَبِي الْفَضْلِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «قُتِلَ مِنْ عَلِيٍّ وَمُعَاوِيَةَ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفًا يَوْمَ صِفِّينَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: Muhammad b. Marwan al-Basri narrated to us, from Kathir Abu al-Fadl, from al-Sha'bi, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Seventy thousand were killed from [the forces of] 'Ali and Mu'awiya on the day of Siffin.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ، يَقُولُ:
entries.matn_ar: " الْخَيْرُ كُلُّهُ فِي هَذَيْنِ الْحَرْفَيْنِ: الْأَخْذُ بِمَا أُمِرْتُمْ، وَالنَّهْيُ عَمَّا نُهِيتُمْ عَنْهُ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. 'Umar narrated to us. He said: I heard al-Hasan say:
entries.matn_en: “All good lies in these two words: taking up what you have been commanded, and abstaining from what you have been forbidden.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا مَعَ الْحَسَنِ، فَوَقَفَ عَلَى قَبْرٍ فَقَالَ: «أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ، عَيْشُ هَذَا آخِرُهُ، مَا خَيْرٌ فِي أَوَّلِهِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: Fudayl b. 'Iyad narrated to us, from Hisham b. Hassan, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were with al-Hasan, and he stopped at a grave and said: “O people, a life whose end is this—what good is there in its beginning?”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحِيمِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ الرَّازِيِّ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كُنَّا عِنْدَ سُفْيَانَ الثَّوْرِيِّ، فَكَانَ إِذَا أَتَاهُ الرَّجُلُ يَطْلُبُ الْعِلْمَ سَأَلَهُ: هَلْ لَكَ وَجْهُ مَعِيشَةٍ؟ فَإِنْ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ فِي كِفَايَةٍ أَمَرَهُ بِطَلَبِ الْعِلْمِ ، وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِي كِفَايَةٍ أَمَرَهُ بِطَلَبِ الْمَعَاشِ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me, from 'Abd al-Rahim b. Sulayman al-Razi, who said:
entries.matn_en: We were with Sufyan al-Thawri, and whenever a man came to him seeking knowledge he would ask him: Do you have a means of livelihood? If he told him that he was provided for, he would command him to seek knowledge; and if he was not provided for, he would command him to seek a livelihood.

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوْنٍ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ سِنَانٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: مَكْتُوبٌ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ: «كَمَا تَدِينُ تُدَانُ، وَكَمَا تَزْرَعُ تَحْصُدُ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: Abu 'Awn al-Hakam b. Sinan narrated to us, from Malik b. Dinar, who said:
entries.matn_en: It is written in the Torah: “As you deal, so shall you be dealt with; and as you sow, so shall you reap.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ النِّيلِيُّ، بِالرَّحَبَةِ رَحَبَةِ طَوْقٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ:
entries.matn_ar: «مَا كَذَبْتُ مُنْذُ شَدَدْتُ عَلَيَّ إِزَارِي»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to me. He said: Muhammad b. Khalid al-Nili narrated to me, in al-Rahaba—Rahabat Tawq. He said: al-Walid b. Muslim narrated to us, from Malik b. Anas, who said: 'Umar b. 'Abd al-'Aziz said:
entries.matn_en: “I have not lied since I tightened my waistcloth (izar) upon me.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنْ ثَوْرٍ، عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " مَنْ حَدَّثَ النَّاسَ بِمَا رَأَتْهُ عَيْنَاهُ، أَوْ سَمِعَتْ أُذُنَاهُ، أَوْ أَخَذَتْهُ يَدَاهُ، فَهُوَ مِنَ {الَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَنْ تَشِيعَ الْفَاحِشَةُ فِي الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا} [النور: 19] "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Muhammad narrated to us. He said: al-Walid narrated to us, from Thawr, from Khalid b. Ma'dan, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Whoever tells people what his two eyes have seen, or his two ears have heard, or his two hands have taken, is among {those who love that indecency should spread among those who believe} [Q. 24:19].”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ: نا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ بَعْضَ السَّلَفِ قَالَ لِرَقِيقٍ لَهُ، وَقَدْ ضَاقَ فِي بَعْضِ الْأَمْرِ: «إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ تُغَيِّرَ خُلُقَكَ بِأَحْسَنَ فَافْعَلْ، وَإِلَّا فَيَسَعُكَ مِنْ أَخْلَاقِنَا مَا ضَاقَ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ خُلُقِكَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to me. He said: Muhammad narrated to me. He said: al-Walid narrated to us, from Sa'id b. 'Abd al-'Aziz:
entries.matn_en: That one of the Salaf said to a slave of his who had become hard-pressed in some matter: “If you are able to change your character for something better, do so; and if not, then of our dispositions there is room for what has become narrow for you in your own disposition.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاتِكَةِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا مُسْلِمٍ الْخَوْلَانِيَّ اشْتَرَى بَغْلَةً، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَتُهُ: ادْعُ اللَّهَ لَنَا فِيهَا بِالْبَرَكَةِ، قَالَ: «اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهَا» ، فَأَصْبَحَتْ وَقَدْ نَفَقَتْ. ثُمَّ اشْتَرَى بَغْلَةً ثَانِيَةً، فَقَالَتْ لَهُ مِثْلَهَا، فَأَصْبَحَتْ وَقَدْ نَفَقَتْ. ثُمَّ اشْتَرَى الثَّالِثَةَ، فَقَالَتْ: أَبَا مُسْلِمٍ، ادْعُ اللَّهَ لَنَا فِيهَا بِالْبَرَكَةِ، فَقَالَ: «اسْكُتِي يَا حَمْقَاءُ، اللَّهُمَّ مَتِّعْنَا بِهَا»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Muhammad narrated to me. He said: al-Walid narrated to us, from 'Uthman b. Abi al-'Atika:
entries.matn_en: That Abu Muslim al-Khawlani bought a mule, and his wife said to him: Pray to God for blessing for us in it. He said: “O God, bless us in it.” But in the morning it had died. Then he bought a second mule, and she said the like of that to him; and in the morning it had died. Then he bought a third, and she said: Abu Muslim, pray to God for blessing for us in it. He said: “Be quiet, you foolish woman! O God, let us enjoy it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جَابِرٍ،
entries.matn_ar: سَمِعَ الْقَاسِمَ بْنَ مُخَيْمِرَةَ، يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ مِنْ إِخْوَانِهِ: أَمْتَعَ اللَّهُ بِكَ، قَالَ: «إِنَّمَا هِيَ دَعْوَةٌ مُحْدَثَةٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Muhammad narrated to me. He said: al-Walid narrated to us, from Ibn Jabir; he heard al-Qasim b. Mukhaymira
entries.matn_en: disliking that one of his brothers should say to him: “May God let you enjoy [a long life] (amta'a Allahu bika).” He said: “It is only a newly introduced supplication.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ أَبَا مُسْلِمٍ الْخَوْلَانِيَّ كَانَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْقِتَالِ: «مَا عَلَيَّ وَقَدْ لَبِسْتُ دِرْعِي، الْيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ عِنْدَ طَاقَتِي»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Muhammad narrated to me. He said: al-Walid narrated to us, from Sa'id b. 'Abd al-'Aziz:
entries.matn_en: That Abu Muslim al-Khawlani used to say in battle: “What is there against me, now that I have put on my coat of mail? Today I shall die at the limit of my capacity.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، عَنْ مُعْتَمِرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، ⦗ص: 69⦘ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «كَانَتْ كِسْوَةُ بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْمُزَنِيِّ تَبْلُغُ أَرْبَعَةَ آلَافٍ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me, from Mu'tamir, from his father, [p. 69] who said:
entries.matn_en: “The clothing of Bakr b. 'Abd Allah al-Muzani amounted to four thousand.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ أَبِي الْوَسِيمِ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ أَبِي شَدَّادٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " كُنْتُ أُلَاعِبُ الْحُسَيْنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ بِالْمَدَاحِي، فَإِذَا أَصَابَتْ مِدْحَاتُهُ حَمَلْتُهُ، وَإِذَا أَصَابَتْ مِدْحَاتِي قُلْتُ: احْمِلْنِي كَمَا حَمَلْتُكَ، قَالَ: «إِنَّهُ لَا يَصْلُحُ أَنْ تَرْكَبَ عَلَى بَضْعَةٍ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: 'Ubayd b. Abi al-Wasim narrated to us, from Salman Abu Shaddad, who said:
entries.matn_en: I used to play al-madahi (a game of throwing flat stones) with al-Husayn b. 'Ali; when his stone hit [the mark] I would carry him, and when my stone hit I would say: Carry me as I carried you. He said: “It is not fitting that you ride upon a part (bad'a) of the Messenger of God ﷺ.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: " يُوَقَّرُ ثَلَاثَةٌ: ذُو الشَّيْبَةِ فِي الْإِسْلَامِ، وَالسُّلْطَانُ الْمُقْسِطُ، وَالْعِلْمُ حَيْثُ كَانَ، مَعَ شَيْخٍ أَوْ شَابٍّ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: Khalid b. Yazid b. Abi Malik narrated to us, from his father, who said:
entries.matn_en: “Three are to be honoured: the one with grey hair in Islam, the just ruler, and knowledge wherever it is, whether with an old man or a young one.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حُمْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ،
entries.matn_ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا أَتَى الْأَحْنَفَ يَسْأَلُهُ، ⦗ص: 70⦘ فَقَالَ: " أَرَاكَ صَحِيحًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: مَهْ، قَدْ عَلِمَ اللَّهُ أَنَّ هَذَا سَيَسْأَلُ "
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to me. He said: Suwayd narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Humran narrated to us, from Ibn 'Awn, from Muhammad, that a man came to al-Ahnaf asking him [for something], [p. 70] and he said:
entries.matn_en: “I see you are healthy.” Then he said: “Enough! God knows that this man is going to ask.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا بَزِيعٌ أَبُو خَازِمٍ، عَنِ الضَّحَّاكِ:
entries.matn_ar: {فَخَانَتَاهُمَا} [التحريم: 10] ، قَالَ: «مَشَتَا بِالنَّمِيمَةِ، كَانَ إِذَا أُوحِيَ إِلَيْهِمَا أَفْشَتَاهُ إِلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: Bazi' Abu Khazim narrated to us, from al-Dahhak:
entries.matn_en: {And the two [women] betrayed them (fa-khanatahuma)} [Q. 66:10]. He said: “They went about with slander (namima): whenever revelation came to the two [prophets], the two women divulged it to the polytheists.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.matn_ar: «وَرَأَيْتُ الضَّحَّاكَ يُصَلِّي فِي لُبَّادَةٍ وَيَدُهُ فِي جَوْفِهَا»
entries.matn_en: “And I saw al-Dahhak praying in a felt cloak (lubbada) with his hand inside it.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بُكَيْرٍ الْغَنَوِيُّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُوقَةَ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ،
entries.matn_ar: فِي قَوْلِهِ: {لَأَقْعُدَنَّ لَهُمْ صِرَاطَكَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ} [الأعراف: 16] ، قَالَ: «طَرِيقُ مَكَّةَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: 'Abd Allah b. Bukayr al-Ghanawi narrated to me, from Muhammad b. Suqa, from 'Awn b. 'Abd Allah, concerning His saying:
entries.matn_en: {I will surely sit in wait for them on Your straight path (sirataka l-mustaqim)} [Q. 7:16]. He said: “The road to Mecca.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا الْمُطَّلِبُ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ سَرِيعٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: رَأَيْتُ عَلِيًّا يَضْرِبُ النَّاسَ بِالدِّرَّةِ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَى بَابِي، قَالَ: قُلْتُ: مَا لَكَ يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ؟ قَالَ: «كُنْتُ أَرَى السُّلْطَانَ يَظْلِمُ النَّاسَ، فَإِذَا النَّاسُ يَظْلِمُونَ السُّلْطَانَ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to us. He said: al-Muttalib narrated to us, from al-Qasim b. Muhammad, from al-Walid b. Sari', from 'Amr b. Hurayth, who said:
entries.matn_en: I saw 'Ali striking people with the whip (dirra) until he reached my door. I said: What is the matter, O Commander of the Believers? He said: “I used to see the ruler wronging the people, and now the people are wronging the ruler.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَائِذٌ بَيَّاعُ الْهَرَوِيِّ، عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي هَاشِمٍ، قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: كَانَ عَلِيٌّ إِذَا أَكَلَ طَعَامًا أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُؤْكَلَ مَعَهُ، إِلَّا الرُّمَّانَ، فَإِنَّهُ يَأْكُلُهُ وَحْدَهُ، وَيَأْكُلُهُ بِشَحْمِهِ، وَيَقُولُ: «إِنَّ فِي كُلِّ رُمَّانَةٍ حَبَّةً مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to us. He said: Suwayd narrated to me. He said: 'A'idh, the seller of al-Harawi [cloth], narrated to us, from a man of Banu Hashim, who said:
entries.matn_en: Whenever 'Ali ate food he liked it to be eaten with him, except pomegranate, which he ate by himself, and he ate it with its pith, saying: “In every pomegranate there is a seed from Paradise.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدٌ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ عَقِيصَا، قَالَ أَبُو حَاتِمٍ: وَهُوَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ، رَوَى عَنْ عَقِيصَا الْأَعْمَشُ، وَفِطْرٌ، وَكَانَ عَقِيصَا مِنَ الشِّيعَةِ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ قَالَ:
entries.matn_ar: «أَنَا لَكُمْ وَزِيرٌ، خَيْرٌ مِنِّي لَكُمْ أَمِيرٌ»
entries.isnad_en: Abu Hatim narrated to me. He said: Suwayd narrated to us. He said: 'Amr b. Thabit narrated to us, from 'Uqaysa—Abu Hatim said: He is Abu Sa'id; al-A'mash and Fitr narrated from 'Uqaysa, and 'Uqaysa was one of the Shi'a—from 'Ali, who said:
entries.matn_en: “I am a vizier (wazir) to you; that is better for you than that I should be a commander (amir) over you.”

entries.label: Narration
entries.isnad_ar: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَاتِمٍ قَالَ: حَدَّثَنِي نُعَيْمُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، قَالَ: حَدَّثَنَا ⦗ص: 72⦘ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَتْ:
